summary: Applied the customer success lens to Calder's portfolio companies and management teams. Agreed that the 100-day plan from week 2 starts within two weeks of completion and that the three largest portfolio companies get a monthly commercial review. Add-on targets are pending and a formal satisfaction survey was declined.

discussion.keyPoints: Helen said the first month after completion is often lost to reporting set-up. The 100-day plan promised to founders needs to start quickly to be credible.
Mark said vendors trust other founders more than Calder's partners. Several exited CEOs have offered to take calls.
Helen wants each platform to make add-on acquisitions. Mark was cautious about committing to a number before the Fund II deployment forecast is clearer.

recommendations.recommendation: Start the 100-day plan within 2 weeks of completion with the named operating partner in place on day one.
Run a monthly commercial review at the 3 largest portfolio companies using the commercial playbook.
Target at least one add-on acquisition per platform company within 24 months.
Build a panel of 5 exited CEOs willing to take reference calls from vendors.
Run an annual survey of portfolio management teams.

actions.action: Contact exited CEOs to confirm the 5 reference panel members

nextFocus: Model the economics of origination, including cost per completed deal and the proprietary programme budget.
nextPreparation: Bring abort costs for the last three years and the proposed marketing and origination budget.

tests.question: Is the add-on acquisition target agreed?
How many exited CEOs are on the reference panel?
